sources.snippet: This paper presents AshenBERTo, a custom-pretrained RoBERTa model optimized for Sinhala sentence similarity tasks. Low-resource languages like Sinhala face challenges due to scarce annotated data and the lack of robust models. To mitigate this, a parallel Sin-hala dataset was created via machine translation of benchmark datasets (SNLI, SICK, STS).
